senses.en: covered with scales, as some fish and reptiles are

example.en: The scaled reptile basked in the sun.
example.zh: 那条有鳞的爬行动物在晒太阳。

senses.en: easy to digest; easy to understand

example.en: The book presents complex ideas in a digestible way.
example.zh: 这本书以易懂的方式呈现复杂的思想。

senses.en: self-restraint, especially regarding sexual activity

example.en: The practice requires continence and discipline.
example.zh: 这种修行要求节制与自律。

senses.en: the ability to control urination and defecation (medical)

example.en: After surgery, the patient gradually regained continence.
example.zh: 手术后，病人逐渐恢复了自制能力。

senses.en: able to be gotten back or recovered, especially from storage or memory

example.en: All the deleted files are still retrievable from the backup.
example.zh: 所有删除的文件仍然可以从备份中恢复。

senses.en: relating to syllables or based on syllables

example.en: Japanese poetry often follows a strict syllabic pattern.
example.zh: 日本诗歌常遵循严格的音节模式。

senses.en: consisting of or using a syllabary (a writing system based on syllables)

example.en: Some ancient scripts are syllabic rather than alphabetic.
example.zh: 一些古代文字是音节文字而非字母文字。

senses.en: the condition of being on board a ship, used mainly in 'on shipboard'
senses.zh: 船上（用于短语 on shipboard）

example.en: They met on shipboard during the voyage.
example.zh: 他们在航行的船上相遇。

senses.en: relating to or taking place on a ship

example.en: The crew stored the shipboard supplies below deck.
example.zh: 船员把船上用品存放在甲板下。

senses.en: to force oneself or an idea on others uninvited

example.en: I don't want to obtrude on their private conversation.
example.zh: 我不想打扰他们的私人谈话。

senses.en: relating to the art of speaking or writing effectively

example.en: He used several rhetorical devices in his speech.
example.zh: 他在演讲中使用了多种修辞手法。

senses.en: using impressive language more for effect than meaning

example.en: The speech was full of rhetorical flourishes but few concrete plans.
example.zh: 这篇演讲辞藻华丽，却很少有具体计划。

senses.en: the sound of something hard being crushed or bitten

example.en: We heard the crunch of gravel under the tires.
example.zh: 我们听到轮胎碾过碎石发出的嘎吱声。

senses.en: to crush or bite something with a loud noise

example.en: She crunched an apple between her teeth.
example.zh: 她嘎吱嘎吱地咬着苹果。

senses.en: a time of difficulty caused by a shortage of time, money, or resources

example.en: The company faced a cash crunch last winter.
example.zh: 公司去年冬天遭遇了资金短缺的危机。

senses.en: a detailed plan or scheme for doing something

example.en: The report lays out a blueprint for economic reform.
example.zh: 这份报告提出了经济改革的蓝图。

senses.en: a technical drawing or print showing a building or machine design

example.en: The engineer studied the blueprint of the new bridge.
example.zh: 工程师研究了新桥的设计图。

senses.en: loose clothing consisting of a top and trousers, worn for sleeping

example.en: He changed into his pajamas before going to bed.
example.zh: 他睡觉前换上了睡衣。

senses.en: a small bottle, especially one holding medicine or a vaccine

example.en: The nurse prepared a vial of vaccine.
example.zh: 护士准备好一瓶疫苗。

senses.en: a group of four musicians or singers performing together
senses.zh: 四重奏；四重唱；四人演奏组

example.en: The string quartet performed Beethoven at the concert.
example.zh: 弦乐四重奏团在音乐会上演奏了贝多芬的作品。

senses.en: a piece of music written for four performers; also, a group of four people or things

example.en: She composed a new quartet for piano and strings.
example.zh: 她为钢琴和弦乐创作了一首新的四重奏曲。

senses.en: a tiny single-celled reproductive body produced by fungi, plants, and some bacteria

example.en: Mushrooms release millions of spores into the air.
example.zh: 蘑菇向空气中释放数百万个孢子。

senses.en: to press something firmly from opposite sides

example.en: She squeezed my hand to reassure me.
example.zh: 她握紧我的手让我安心。

senses.en: to get liquid from something by pressing it

example.en: She squeezed some juice from an orange.
example.zh: 她从橙子里挤出一些果汁。

senses.en: an act of pressing something firmly, often with the hand

example.en: He gave my shoulder a quick squeeze.
example.zh: 他快速捏了一下我的肩膀。

senses.en: the quality of staying steady and not changing or failing

example.en: Economic stability helps businesses plan for the future.
example.zh: 经济稳定有助于企业规划未来。

senses.en: the quality of being firm and not likely to move or fall

example.en: The stability of the ladder depends on level ground.
example.zh: 梯子的稳固性取决于地面是否平整。

senses.en: to a severe or serious degree

example.en: She was badly injured in the fall.
example.zh: 她在摔倒时受了重伤。

senses.en: in a poor or unsatisfactory way

example.en: He did badly on the test.
example.zh: 他这次考试考得很差。

senses.en: very much or urgently

example.en: I need this information badly.
example.zh: 我非常需要这个信息。

senses.en: a detailed list of items, especially goods in stock

example.en: The manager checked the inventory before placing a new order.
example.zh: 经理在下新订单之前核对了存货清单。

senses.en: the stock of goods a store or business has on hand

example.en: The store reduced its inventory with a big sale.
example.zh: 这家店通过大减价减少了库存。

senses.en: to make a complete list of items

example.en: They inventoried the warehouse supplies at the end of the year.
example.zh: 他们在年底清点了仓库物资。

senses.en: to a greater degree than usual; particularly

example.en: I love fruit, especially mangoes.
example.zh: 我喜欢水果，尤其是芒果。

senses.en: for a particular purpose or person; specifically

example.en: The book is written especially for beginners.
example.zh: 这本书是专为初学者写的。

senses.en: something that someone says or writes to express a fact, opinion, or claim

example.en: Her statement was brief and clear.
example.zh: 她的陈述简短明了。

senses.en: an official or formal public announcement

example.en: The company issued a statement about the delay.
example.zh: 公司就延误发表了一份声明。

senses.en: a printed or online record of money paid into and taken out of an account

example.en: He checked his bank statement online.
example.zh: 他在网上查看了银行对账单。

senses.en: to choose someone or something from a group, usually after thinking carefully

example.en: The committee will select a new chair next week.
example.zh: 委员会将在下周选出新主席。

senses.en: carefully chosen as the best or most suitable; available only to a small group
senses.zh: 精选的；专为少数人提供的

example.en: The restaurant has a select menu of local dishes.
example.zh: 这家餐厅有一份精选的本地菜菜单。

senses.en: to need someone or something in order to live, work, or succeed

example.en: Many small businesses rely on local customers.
example.zh: 许多小企业依赖本地顾客。

senses.en: to trust someone or something to do what is needed
senses.zh: 信赖；相信（某人会做某事）

example.en: You can rely on her to keep a secret.
example.zh: 你可以相信她会保守秘密。

collocations: rely on someone to do something

senses.en: the amount by which money spent or owed is greater than money received or available
senses.zh: 赤字；支出超过收入的差额

example.en: The government is trying to reduce the budget deficit.
example.zh: 政府正努力减少预算赤字。

senses.en: a lack or shortage of something needed or expected

example.en: The school faces a deficit of qualified teachers.
example.zh: 这所学校面临合格教师短缺。

senses.en: a loss or impairment in a function of the body or mind

example.en: The patient showed a mild memory deficit after the illness.
example.zh: 患病后，患者表现出轻度记忆障碍。

senses.en: an organized attempt to overthrow a government or authority

example.en: The peasants launched a revolt against the king.
example.zh: 农民发动了反抗国王的起义。

senses.en: to rise up against an authority or government

example.en: The colonists revolted against British rule.
example.zh: 殖民地居民奋起反抗英国的统治。

senses.en: to make someone feel disgusted

example.en: The violence in the film revolted many viewers.
example.zh: 影片中的暴力让许多观众感到反感。

senses.en: to undo a knot or something that is tied

example.en: She untied her shoelaces before taking off the shoes.
example.zh: 她脱鞋前先解开了鞋带。

senses.en: the middle of the day, twelve o'clock

example.en: The meeting starts at noon sharp.
example.zh: 会议十二点整开始。

senses.en: a room where a court of law holds trials and hearings

example.en: The courtroom was filled with reporters during the trial.
example.zh: 审判期间，法庭里坐满了记者。

senses.en: in an active, energetic way

example.en: She actively participates in class discussions.
example.zh: 她积极参加课堂讨论。

senses.en: in a way that involves taking action rather than being passive

example.en: The police are actively investigating the case.
example.zh: 警方正在积极调查此案。

senses.en: a session of physical exercise to keep fit

example.en: I had a good workout at the gym this morning.
example.zh: 我今天早上在健身房锻炼得很尽兴。

senses.en: a person who skis

example.en: The skier raced down the mountain.
example.zh: 滑雪者从山上飞驰而下。

senses.en: a thick sweet liquid made from sugar, often used on food or in drinks

example.en: She poured maple syrup over her pancakes.
example.zh: 她在煎饼上倒了枫糖浆。

senses.en: a thick sweet liquid made from fruit or used as a medicine base

example.en: The pharmacist mixed the medicine into a fruit syrup.
example.zh: 药剂师把药混入果汁糖浆中。

senses.en: to make someone or something look or feel young or energetic again

example.en: A short vacation can rejuvenate both your body and mind.
example.zh: 短暂的假期能让你的身心都恢复活力。

senses.en: to restore something old or tired to better condition

example.en: The city plans to rejuvenate its old downtown area.
example.zh: 该市计划让老旧的市中心区域焕然一新。

senses.en: organized according to a system or method; done in a careful, regular way (a less common variant of "systematic")
senses.zh: 有系统的；有条理的；成体系的

example.en: She made a systematical study of all the records before writing her report.
example.zh: 她在写报告之前对所有记录进行了系统的研究。

senses.en: at or toward the back of something

example.en: The garden is behind the house.
example.zh: 花园在房子后面。

senses.en: in or toward the rear; remaining after someone has left

example.en: She stayed behind after class.
example.zh: 课后她留了下来。

senses.en: lagging behind in progress or score

example.en: Our team is behind by two points.
example.zh: 我们队落后两分。

senses.en: (informal) the part of the body you sit on

example.en: He fell down and landed on his behind.
example.zh: 他摔了个屁股着地。

senses.en: the continent between the Atlantic Ocean and Asia

example.en: She traveled across Europe by train last summer.
example.zh: 去年夏天她乘火车游遍欧洲。

senses.en: the European Union

example.en: Britain's decision to leave Europe surprised many people.
example.zh: 英国脱欧的决定让许多人感到意外。

senses.en: coming next after the second in position or order

example.en: She finished third in the race.
example.zh: 她在比赛中得了第三名。

senses.en: one of three equal parts of something

example.en: Two thirds of the students passed the exam.
example.zh: 三分之二的学生通过了考试。

senses.en: of the color of blood or fire

example.en: She wore a red dress to the party.
example.zh: 她穿了一条红裙子去参加聚会。

senses.en: the color of blood; red color

example.en: Red is a warm color.
example.zh: 红色是暖色。

senses.en: not including; other than

example.en: Everyone passed the exam except Tom.
example.zh: 除了汤姆，大家都通过了考试。

senses.en: used before a clause meaning 'but that' or 'only that'

example.en: I would join you, except I have to work late.
example.zh: 我本想和你一起去，只是我得加班。

senses.en: to leave out or exclude from a general statement

example.en: The rule excepts members who joined before 2020.
example.zh: 该规定将2020年前加入的成员除外。

senses.en: a police officer (informal)

example.en: A cop directed traffic at the busy intersection.
example.zh: 一名警察在繁忙的十字路口指挥交通。

senses.en: to steal or take something (informal)

example.en: He managed to cop the last concert ticket.
example.zh: 他设法抢到了最后一张演唱会门票。

senses.en: to admit to something, especially guilt (informal)

example.en: She decided to cop to her mistake and apologize.
example.zh: 她决定承认错误并道歉。

senses.en: not willing to say much about one's thoughts or feelings

example.en: He is reticent about his private life.
example.zh: 他对自己的私生活讳莫如深。

senses.en: a tax on goods such as tobacco, alcohol, or fuel

example.en: The government raised the excise on cigarettes.
example.zh: 政府提高了香烟的消费税。

senses.en: to remove something by cutting it out or deleting it

example.en: The surgeon excised the tumor successfully.
example.zh: 医生成功切除了肿瘤。

senses.en: the main point or general meaning of something said or written

example.en: I missed the details, but I got the gist of his argument.
example.zh: 我错过了细节，但我领会了他论点的大意。

senses.en: the quality of being extremely large in size, area, or extent

example.en: They stood in awe of the vastness of the desert.
example.zh: 他们对沙漠的浩瀚感到敬畏。

senses.en: a cultivated flower with pink, red, or white frilly petals

example.en: He gave his mother a bunch of carnations on Mother's Day.
example.zh: 母亲节那天他送了母亲一束康乃馨。

senses.en: a pinkish color

example.en: The dress was a soft shade of carnation.
example.zh: 这条裙子是柔和的粉红色。

senses.en: to polish metal or another hard surface until it is smooth and shiny

example.en: The silversmith burnished the tray until it gleamed.
example.zh: 银匠把托盘擦得闪闪发亮。

senses.en: to improve or strengthen an image or reputation

example.en: The company hired a new spokesperson to burnish its image.
example.zh: 公司聘请了一位新发言人来提升自身形象。

senses.en: clear, logical and convincing
senses.zh: 有说服力的；令人信服的

example.en: She presented a cogent argument for the new policy.
example.zh: 她为新政策提出了令人信服的论据。

senses.en: to die or struggle because there is not enough air; to feel unable to breathe

example.en: The smoke made it hard to breathe, and the trapped workers nearly suffocated.
example.zh: 浓烟让人难以呼吸，被困的工人几乎窒息。

senses.en: to feel trapped or restricted, as if unable to breathe freely

example.en: She felt she was suffocating in that stressful job.
example.zh: 她觉得那份高压工作让她喘不过气来。

senses.en: a short period of rest or relief from something difficult

example.en: The cool evening breeze offered a brief respite from the heat.
example.zh: 凉爽的晚风让人从炎热中得到片刻喘息。

senses.en: a delay in the carrying out of a punishment or task

example.en: The court granted a respite before the sentence took effect.
example.zh: 法院在判决生效前给予了缓期。

senses.en: a hard yellow-brown fossil resin used for jewelry

example.en: She wore a necklace made of amber beads.
example.zh: 她戴了一条琥珀珠子项链。

senses.en: a deep yellow-orange color

example.en: The sunset turned the sky a warm amber.
example.zh: 日落把天空染成温暖的琥珀色。

senses.en: of a medium to dark yellow-brown color

example.en: The wine had a rich amber color.
example.zh: 这酒有着浓郁的琥珀色。

senses.en: a feeling of great happiness

example.en: Her face lit up with joy when she heard the news.
example.zh: 听到这个消息时，她脸上洋溢着喜悦。

senses.en: a person or thing that makes someone very happy
senses.zh: 令人高兴的人或事；快乐源泉

example.en: Her grandchildren are her greatest joy.
example.zh: 她的孙辈是她最大的快乐。

senses.en: a connection or relationship between two things or people

example.en: There is a strong link between exercise and good health.
example.zh: 运动与健康之间有很强的联系。

senses.en: to connect two or more things or people

example.en: The new road links the village to the town.
example.zh: 这条新路把村庄和城镇连接起来。

senses.en: a word or image on a computer screen that opens another page when clicked

example.en: Click the link to open the website.
example.zh: 点击链接打开网站。

senses.en: one ring of a chain

example.en: One link in the chain was broken.
example.zh: 链条上的一个链环断了。

senses.en: a set of rules a computer follows to solve a problem
senses.zh: 计算机解决问题所遵循的一套规则

example.en: The search algorithm ranks pages by relevance.
example.zh: 该搜索算法按相关性对页面进行排名。

senses.en: a step-by-step method for solving a problem

example.en: She followed a simple algorithm to choose the best route.
example.zh: 她按照一个简单的算法来选择最佳路线。

senses.en: the quality of being hard to do or understand

example.en: The difficulty of the task surprised us.
example.zh: 这项任务的难度让我们吃惊。

senses.en: a problem or situation that makes something hard

example.en: We ran into a technical difficulty.
example.zh: 我们遇到了一个技术难题。

senses.en: a situation in which someone has problems or needs help

example.en: The family is in financial difficulty.
example.zh: 这个家庭陷入经济困难。

senses.en: used to show an exact place or position

example.en: She is waiting at the door.
example.zh: 她在门口等着。

senses.en: used to show an exact time

example.en: The meeting starts at noon.
example.zh: 会议中午开始。

senses.en: used to show a level, rate, or price
senses.zh: 以（表示水平、速度或价格）

example.en: We bought the tickets at a low price.
example.zh: 我们以低价买了票。

senses.en: happening by chance, unexpectedly or unintentionally

example.en: The accidental damage to the file was quickly fixed.
example.zh: 文件的意外损坏很快被修复了。

senses.en: not essential or of central importance

example.en: The differences are accidental and not central to the argument.
example.zh: 这些差异是次要的，并非论点的核心。

senses.en: a sign in music, such as a sharp, flat or natural, placed before a note

example.en: The composer added an accidental to change the pitch of the note.
example.zh: 作曲家加了一个临时记号来改变该音的音高。

senses.en: feeling or showing no hope; seeming impossible to improve

example.en: After losing his job, he felt hopeless about the future.
example.zh: 失业后，他对未来感到绝望。

senses.en: very bad at doing something; lacking skill
senses.zh: 笨拙的；不擅长的（尤用于口语）

example.en: I'm hopeless at cooking — I even burn boiled eggs.
example.zh: 我完全不擅长做饭——连煮鸡蛋都会烧糊。

senses.en: a small bed for a baby that can be rocked

example.en: The mother gently rocked the cradle until the baby fell asleep.
example.zh: 母亲轻轻摇晃摇篮，直到宝宝睡着。

senses.en: the place where something important began or developed

example.en: Mesopotamia is often called the cradle of civilization.
example.zh: 美索不达米亚常被称为文明的摇篮。

senses.en: to hold something gently and protectively

example.en: She cradled the sleeping infant in her arms.
example.zh: 她把熟睡的婴儿轻轻抱在怀里。

senses.en: to break something into pieces violently

example.en: He smashed the vase on the floor.
example.zh: 他把花瓶摔碎在地板上。

senses.en: to hit something or someone very hard

example.en: She smashed the ball over the net.
example.zh: 她把球猛扣过网。

senses.en: a hard hit or a violent collision

example.en: Two cars were involved in a smash on the highway.
example.zh: 两辆汽车在高速公路上相撞。

senses.en: something, especially a show or song, that is very successful

example.en: The movie was a box-office smash.
example.zh: 这部电影非常卖座。

senses.en: a very large quantity; more than enough

example.en: The region has an abundance of fresh fruit in summer.
example.zh: 该地区夏季盛产新鲜水果。

senses.en: (in physics or chemistry) the relative amount of an isotope or element compared with the total

example.en: Scientists measured the isotopic abundance of carbon in the sample.
example.zh: 科学家测量了样品中碳的同位素丰度。

senses.en: having mixed or contradictory feelings about something
senses.zh: （情绪、态度）矛盾的；摇摆不定的

example.en: She felt ambivalent about moving to a new city.
example.zh: 她对搬到新城市的心情很矛盾。

senses.en: willing to try new, exciting, or risky things

example.en: She is adventurous and loves traveling alone.
example.zh: 她爱冒险，喜欢独自旅行。

senses.en: to beat someone severely with a whip or rod as punishment

example.en: In the past, prisoners were sometimes flogged as punishment.
example.zh: 过去，囚犯有时会被鞭笞作为惩罚。

senses.en: (British informal) to sell something

example.en: He tried to flog his old car to his neighbors.
example.zh: 他试图把旧车卖给邻居们。

senses.en: a very small brown bird with a short upright tail

example.en: A wren flitted through the hedges.
example.zh: 一只鹪鹩飞快地掠过树篱。

senses.en: money taken from a bank account beyond the amount available in it, often with the bank’s permission

example.en: She arranged an overdraft with her bank.
example.zh: 她与银行办理了透支安排。

senses.en: not strict or careful enough about rules or standards

example.en: Security at the airport was criticized as lax.
example.zh: 机场的安检被批评为松懈。

senses.en: extremely large, powerful, or impressive

example.en: The ship was swallowed by a prodigious wave.
example.zh: 那艘船被一个巨浪吞没了。

senses.en: to take control of a territory and add it to a country

example.en: The empire annexed the neighboring territory in 1870.
example.zh: 该帝国于1870年吞并了邻近的领土。

senses.en: a building added onto or next to a main building
senses.zh: 附属建筑；（主楼的）附加建筑

example.en: The hotel built an annex to hold more guests.
example.zh: 酒店新建了一座附楼以容纳更多客人。

senses.en: not allowed or qualified to do or receive something

example.en: He was ineligible for the scholarship because of his residency status.
example.zh: 由于居住身份原因，他没有资格申请这项奖学金。

senses.en: in a slanting direction, from one corner to the opposite one

example.en: Cut the cloth diagonally to make two triangles.
example.zh: 把布斜着剪成两个三角形。

senses.en: an electronic keyboard instrument that generates and changes sounds

example.en: He plays the synthesizer in a rock band.
example.zh: 他在一支摇滚乐队里弹合成器。

senses.en: having little rainfall but not completely dry; somewhat arid

example.en: Grasslands cover much of the semiarid region.
example.zh: 草原覆盖了大部分半干旱地区。
